skills.name: Ring of Order
skills.description:
Kaja releases a Ringed Electric Blade that quickly expands and contracts, dealing 135<font color='#27C0C7'>( +70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies hit on its way out and back and <font color='#404495'>(paralyzing)</font> them. Enemies hit will also have their positions revealed briefly.
Each time Electric Blade deals damage, Kaja restores 100 HP (decays to 30% after multiple hits).
skills.tips: Kaja releases a ringed, electric blade that quickly expands and contracts. Deals magic damage to enemy targets and briefly slows them. When the electric current hits the enemy target, Kaja will unleash a bolt of lightening that briefly deals continuous magical damage to the nearest enemy target. Damage gradually increases when the bolt of lightening continuously hits the same target.

skills.name: Lightning Bomb
skills.description: Kaja dashes in the target direction while leaving 3 Lightning Bombs along the way. The Bombs will explode upon enemy contact, dealing 150<font color='#27C0C7'>( +35% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to the enemies and <font color='#404495'>(paralyzing)</font> them.
skills.tips: Kaja charges in a specified direction, dealing magic damage to enemies in his path. If Kaja encounters a friendly unit while charging, he moves again in their movement direction and provides himself and allied heroes with a shield, while also increasing movement speed.

skills.name: Divine Judgment
skills.description:
Kaja deals 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to a designated enemy hero, suppresses and <font color='#404495'>(paralyzes)</font> them for 1.5s.
During the suppression, Kaja can drag the enemy hero along with him.
skills.tips: Kaja pulls and suppresses a target enemy hero. Deals magic damage for 2 seconds. During that time, the enemy hero’s magic resistance is reduced. Kaja absorbs the target enemy hero’s lost magical resistance, making it his own.

skills.name: Wrath Sanction
skills.description:
Kaja achieves Wrath Sanction every 6s. His next Basic Attack will send lightning at enemies, dealing <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> equal to 100<font color='#27C0C7'>( +100% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 4% of targets' Max HP and <font color='#404495'>(paralyzing)</font> them. The lightning will jump to enemies nearby as well (up to 3 times).
Increases damage by 200% of targets' Max HP on Minions and Creeps.
<font color='#404495'>(Paralyze)</font>: Slows enemy heroes and summons while reducing their damage by 3% (up to 8 stacks) for 5s.
skills.tips: Receiving damage from enemy heroes increases Khaja’s movement speed by 40%, quickly decreasing within 1 second. Effect can be triggered every 5 seconds.

items.name: Antique Cuirass
items.des: Unique Passive - Deter: When hit by a skill, reduces the attacker's Physical Damage by 4% for 2s (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.

items.name: Glowing Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Scorch: Burn targets for 3s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1.5% of the target's Max HP per second.

builds.tips: In early game, Demon’s Advent provides strong damage reduction effects, which truly makes a difference during scrimmages. Together, with the physical defense of Warrior Boots, make Kaja adept at ganking with his allies. Blade Armor is also a good choice due to its damage reduction effect and damage return effect—This is especially strong against assassins and marksmen. Once Kaja’s physical defense reaches a certain level, equip Cursed Helmet to increase Kaja’s magic defense and DPS. During late game, Athena's Shield and Immortality are the best choices for this build. Kaja can ensure a safe exit from a scrimmage, after unleashing his ultimate in a group of enemies.
